logic: The previous completed UTC-day high and low are paired daily-scale external liquidity.
The first one-sided raid and completed 15-minute reclaim begins a candidate liquidity-acquisition narrative, not an automatic reversal entry.
A later completed five-minute displacement through a causally confirmed swing must create a genuine three-candle FVG; the raid extreme remains the protected origin.
The FVG midpoint is the internal rebalance and the untouched opposite prior-day boundary is the scale-matched external draw.
Entry, stop, target and exit are consequences of the same external-to-internal-to-external narrative.

actions.PASSIVE: rest at the genuine 5m FVG midpoint with 1bp penetration; pending order occupies the global slot
actions.CONFIRMED: first midpoint interaction plus ten complete post-touch 500ms buckets that retain the FVG and recover in the narrative direction; enter after sensor availability plus 500ms
actions.FLAT: no fill, structural cancellation, origin loss or target consumption before entry

data.microbar: registered official-Bybit sparse500 V5 public-trade shards with exact first/high/low/last event offsets
data.coverage_limit: quarterly-month fatal screen, not a complete annual or official account path

execution.pivot_availability: after both right-side bars complete and only from the following bar
execution.passive_fill: exact public-trade interaction; no touch-only fill and no pre-entry bucket extrema
execution.barrier_order: exact event offsets in the entry minute; exact ties adverse stop-first; later ambiguous 1m bars stop-first

programization_corrections: post-touch sensor starts at the next full 500ms bucket
entry-bucket extrema before exact fill cannot trigger later barriers
all genuine-FVG source bars must be complete
slot release follows the fully observed exit minute
cost tags use rounded basis points
chronology: 2021 quarterly development diagnostic; unchanged 2022 quarterly forward screen; no ML or later period after forward failure
